mode: built-in image_gen; generate using functional references and a separate style reference

prompts.bench:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW original industrial design sketch sheet on pure white, landscape 3:2, four clearly separated drawings in a clean 2x2 arrangement, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no arrows. Image 1 is a functional reference only: adjustable bench plus visible organised weights. Image 2 is a STYLE reference only: fine slightly uneven black pen and pencil construction lines, restrained warm brown and warm gray marker fills, selected soft shadows, clear perspective, exploratory design presentation, NOT polished glossy 3D rendering and NOT copied product geometry.
Design a home exercise furniture system with a low long bench on two broad floor end frames, exposed structural lower crossmember, warm gray frames, muted brown contact cushions. Visible individual recessed cradles for just two small dumbbells, a separate light-object cubby with one soft ball, and a closed low heavy-item bay. ONE foldable two-part exercise floor panel is stored in a narrow end slot when not in use. No permanent high rear handrail. A separate short side support handle tied to the structural end frame may be shown but is not a band anchor. No wheels. No dimensions.
TOP LEFT: large main three-quarter front view, short fixed seat cushion horizontal and long separate backrest cushion tilted up on an obviously supported rigid strut, so it reads as an adjustable bench, not a chair leaning on a cabinet. This is optional exploration, no exerciser on the inclined backrest.
TOP RIGHT: same bench in FLAT horizontal mode, small lightly coloured older woman sitting naturally on the short fixed seat near the end, both feet on floor, arms crossed at chest, clearly visible seat support. ONE floor panel folded in end slot. Fit body correctly on seat. White background, no room decor.
BOTTOM LEFT: same bench flat behind, ONE exercise panel removed from end slot (slot visibly EMPTY), young man doing a modified pushup from knees on the panel in front. Natural two arms, two hands, two legs, no extra limbs. No loose weights in movement area.
BOTTOM RIGHT: an exploded assembly SKETCH of same bench only: the two broad end frames and structural lower crossmember remain visibly connected as one base, the two upper brown cushion contact pieces are lifted straight up aligned with frame, thin warm gray storage insert is separated sideways and a single dumbbell is lifted out of its cradle. Show only 4-5 major pieces, not hundreds of screws; no invented bolts or false technical detail. Keep all pieces coherent and visibly related to assembled product. These are concept parts only, not engineering proof. Balanced margin and ample white between drawings.
prompts.wall:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW original industrial design sketch sheet on pure white, landscape 3:2, four clearly separated drawings in a 2x2 arrangement, without text, letters, numbers, logos, arrows or decorative UI. Image 1 is a functional reference ONLY: shallow wall-mounted home exercise storage with visible designated spaces. Image 2 is a STYLE reference ONLY: delicate black pen and pencil industrial design linework, subtle warm brown and gray marker fills, sparse construction lines, small shadows, exploratory perspective sketches, not shiny photoreal 3D rendering. Create original geometry and do not reproduce logos or the photographed cabinet exactly.
Proposed system: a shallow warm-gray wall panel with a visible faint vertical wall rectangle behind it. Light brown inset storage surfaces, a visible small light-object cubby, one pair of small dumbbells in a separate lower compartment, and a narrow vertical end sleeve for ONE two-part brown folding floor pad. A central brown padded seat folds DOWN from the wall panel. When horizontal the seat is supported on TWO clearly visible front floor feet connected as one U-shaped frame: one leg left and one leg right, both attached to underside corners, both resting on FLOOR. The panel is conceptually wall-mounted but do NOT draw detailed anchors, screws, or claim engineering. Seat loading and wall mounting must be checked later. No wheels, no pullup bar, no elastic bands attached to wall, no people hanging from anything.
TOP LEFT: main three-quarter view of wall panel in stored state, the fold-down seat vertical and latched flush in centre, light and heavy bays separate on sides, floor pad folded in sleeve, closed heavy compartment. A thin pale wall and floor line establish installation.
TOP RIGHT: same wall panel, padded seat lowered to horizontal, two front floor support legs obviously separate left and right beyond an older woman's body, elderly woman seated facing outward, both shoes flat on floor, preparing to stand, arms lightly crossed at chest. Back edge of seat attached to lower wall panel; front edge on U-frame. Floor pad folded in end sleeve.
BOTTOM LEFT: same wall panel stored seat vertical behind a child on ONE unfolded floor panel on floor with one supervising adult. The child is on hands and knees extending one arm and opposite leg. The panel end storage sleeve is visibly EMPTY because the only floor pad is on floor. Keep anatomy natural. No high bench exercise.
BOTTOM RIGHT: young man putting two small dumbbells back into the OPEN lower compartment of the same wall panel, low but reachable from a natural half kneeling pose. The pad has been folded and returned to sleeve. Central seat is vertical in stored state. Show both hands, dumbbells and clear access to compartment. Light cubby holds a soft ball, heavy compartment alone is open. All four drawings clearly refer to same system. White background, generous margins. No room staging.
